irr_limitation: Single annotator. No independent human inter-rater reliability (Cohen's kappa or Krippendorff's alpha) has been computed or is available. Labels are treated as exploratory training targets only.
acceptance_criteria_note: The approved v1.2 preregistration does NOT specify numeric thresholds for delta_min or alpha. Formal PASS/FAIL for Gate 1 (substantive gain) and Gate 2 (statistical significance) is therefore not possible. Gate 3 (zone-level non-regression) is evaluable without numeric thresholds.
